shared_elements: row of short angular/stepped strokes forming a zigzag or comb-like band
long shallow incised line running beneath/alongside the zigzag row
schematic, possibly zoomorphic elongated form set diagonally across the surface
sparse isolated engraved marks in the surrounding field
justification: Both surfaces show an elongated, diagonally set schematic figure built from a row of short angular, stepped or comb-like strokes running along a longer, shallower incised line, with only sparse marks elsewhere on an otherwise blank field, which is a fairly specific structural correspondence. However, in A the toothed band sits over a body with descending linear appendages (reading fish- or plant-like), while in B the stepped elements branch off a single sweeping arc and terminate in a raised head-like projection, so the identity and internal organisation of the figure differ.
